race.title: Ladbrokes Ascot Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Ascot Hurdle) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: KATEIRA showed she retains plenty of speed when scoring at Wetherby last time, and Dan Skelton's smashing mare can gain a deserved first success in Grade 2 company. Lucky Place is most likely to get the run of things and may edge Altobelli for second. KATEIRA LUCKY PLACE (FR) ALTOBELLI (IRE)
